create.name: Kristyn Rose Foster
create.bio:
Kristyn Rose Foster is a yoga and Yoga Nidra teacher from British Columbia who divides her year between Vancouver Island and Costa Rica. She has trained for more than 500 hours across Hatha, Yin and restorative yoga, with advanced study in Yoga Nidra, and her teaching centres on rest as a doorway to awareness. Classical yogic ideas such as the koshas, sankalpa and the search for one's dharma sit alongside slow, quiet practice on the mat.

She teaches through guided recordings, online trainings and retreats. Her YouTube channel and Insight Timer library hold long Yoga Nidra sessions, body scans, sankalpa meditations and Yin sequences, some paired with Reiki. Conscious Yin, her 100-hour online training, blends Yin postures, Yoga Nidra, mindfulness and contemplative study over sixteen weeks for practitioners and teachers. In person she leads small retreats at centres on Bowen and Cortes Islands in British Columbia and in Nosara, Costa Rica, often with fellow teacher Sarah Henderson, and helps lead trainings and an India pilgrimage with TRU Yoga School. She also keeps a members' community on Patreon with longer and ad-free practices.

courses.title: Conscious Yin: The Art of Deep Rest & Inner Awakening
courses.description: A 100-hour online Yin Yoga training over sixteen weeks, with about a quarter of the hours given to Yoga Nidra, meditation and mindfulness. It covers functional Yin, anatomy, yogic philosophy and teaching skills, with live weekly classes and mentoring.

courses.title: The Heart of Yin: A Yin Yoga & Yoga Nidra Retreat
courses.description: Seven nights at a small retreat house near the beach in Nosara on Costa Rica's Pacific coast. Days combine Yin Yoga, Yoga Nidra, meditation, breathwork, mantra and a cacao ceremony, with free afternoons.

courses.title: The Art of Sacred Rest - with Kristyn Rose & Sarah
courses.description: A five-day retreat at Nectar Yoga Retreat Centre on Bowen Island, led with Sarah Henderson. It weaves yoga, Yoga Nidra, sound and simple ritual with plant-based meals and time outdoors.

courses.title: India Pilgrimage 2027 with TRU Yoga
courses.description: An eleven-day yoga pilgrimage in South India, starting near Auroville and travelling on to Tiruvannamalai and the sacred hill of Arunachala. Daily practice, temple visits and quiet reflection run through the journey.

courses.title: Journey Into Being (Patreon membership)
courses.description: A members' library of ad-free Yoga Nidra and guided relaxation practices, including longer sessions, with monthly live gatherings online.

free_resources.title: Kristyn Rose Foster on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large library of Kristyn's Yoga Nidra, non-sleep deep rest and guided relaxation recordings, from short resets to long sessions. They are free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Free 45-Minute Yin and Yoga Nidra Practice
free_resources.description: A full-length class she offers free from her training page, moving through gentle Yin postures for the hips, neck and shoulders before settling into Yoga Nidra.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 13.1k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 89.4k (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 3,391 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook count not read → ~106k total → luminary
flags: Tier borderline: about 106k total, just over the 100k luminary line; YouTube alone is 89.4k.
Base: Insight Timer gives Victoria, BC; her Hollyhock bio says she lives between Vancouver Island and Costa Rica. Set as local_online in Victoria; a human may prefer worldwide.
The Heart of Yin (March 2027) is marked FULL with a waitlist on her retreats page but 'Registration open' on its own page.
India Pilgrimage is listed on her retreats page but the TRU Yoga page itself does not name her; price taken from the TRU page.
Her site's dates for Soul Nectar disagree between pages (August or October 2026 vs July and October 2027), so Soul Nectar was left out.

Many of her YouTube and Insight Timer titles mention sleep, insomnia or nervous system 'healing'; those were left out and only relaxation, rest and practice titles kept. Two kept videos pair Yoga Nidra with Reiki.
A second address, kristynroseyoga@gmail.com, also appears on her retreat and training pages; the plan uses wellness@kristynroseyoga.ca from the site footer.
left_out: Return to Stillness at Hollyhock (2 to 7 Oct 2026) and Soul Nectar (Aug and Oct 2026): dated and already started or past by 31 Oct 2026.
250-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uvita, Costa Rica (TRU Yoga, 2027): waitlist only, no page of its own found with dates or her name.
Private and group Reiki sessions: mentioned on her home page with no page, price or booking link.
YouTube and Insight Timer tracks titled for insomnia, deep sleep, falling asleep, nervous system healing or vagus nerve: health-claim rule.
Patreon tier prices are not shown publicly, so the membership is 'Contact for pricing'.
